CHAPTER 8 · ITEM 02 / 13

Tax revenue and deadweight loss

Revenue versus spending稅收、支出與收入

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate government revenue as tax per unit × quantity traded after tax; distinguish buyer spending Pb × Q from seller receipts Ps × Q.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

政府稅收是 t 乘稅後交易量；買方支出為 Pb×Qt，賣方淨收為 Ps×Qt，差額就是稅收。

Government revenue is t times post-tax quantity. Buyers spend Pb×Qt, while sellers receive net receipts Ps×Qt. The difference between these two amounts is government tax revenue.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Pb=12,Ps=9,Q=100. Buyer spending=1,200; seller receipts=900; government revenue=300. 三個金額需分開。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

t=5 and post-tax Q=80. Government revenue? 政府收入？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
